request: By default attempt to collect artifact-provided source associations; expose repository, full commit, artifact binding evidence and gaps when preparing later version or release-scope comparison. Keep Git comparison and release membership outside this Skill.
changes: Query npm exact-version gitHead/repository alongside artifact digest metadata.
Add ecosystem-specific source field discovery and a bounded default collection path, with no ordinary-inventory bulk payload download.
Keep artifact digest, source commit, repository, component/build scope and evidence together; distinguish claims, verified provenance bindings and incomplete/conflicting data.
Require explicit source-association handoff or missing fields for comparison/release-scope use, while keeping ordinary inventory narrative compact.
Forbid inferring published source from local HEAD, mutable source refs, CI or source history; baseline and target selection remain downstream.
version_rationale: MAJOR under CONTRIBUTING: adds a required default collection attempt and conditional handoff output obligations that were optional in 0.2.0. This independent Skill version does not promote the product stable-core contract or certify runtime maturity.
migration: Consumers invoking 0.2.0 must account for bounded source metadata reads and explicit association/gap reporting for comparison-oriented requests; no new mandatory user input, stored configuration or privilege is introduced.
